summary.description: What it is about, for the journal ({alias} names an alias).

stages.description: The first is where it begins.

deadline.description: Game hours: past them an active quest fails (an offer is withdrawn).

repeat.description: May begin again once over: each day, or at once.

offer.description: The giver's lines: offering, on being accepted or declined, while it runs.

QuestKind.description: The main line, someone's errand, a radiant favour, or a guide: the companion's teaching of one of the game's systems, told beside the main line in her panel.

type.description: Is-a match against the type hierarchy (prefix on slash paths): `actor`, `item/food`, `tile/grass`…

find.description: The first, nearest or a random thing matching (never another alias's), on a map or near another alias.

make.description: A thing made when the quest begins: in an alias's bag, or at a spot.

from.description: A role of the news that began it (radiant).

match.description: What the alias must be (a thing found or taken from the news): else the quest does not begin.

place.description: A place: a map, or a named area (`map:region`).

optional.description: It may stay empty (else a quest that cannot fill it does not begin).

essential.description: While the quest runs, they cannot die (they go down).

keep.description: While the quest runs, a quest item (no merchant buys it).

AliasDef.description: Who or what a quest is about (Skyrim's aliases), filled when it begins or is offered.

type.description: Is-a match against the type hierarchy (prefix on slash paths): `actor`, `item/food`, `tile/grass`…

Selector.description: Selects the entity or tile filling a role. All given constraints must hold.

text.description: What it asks ({alias} names an alias).

target.description: What it points at (aliases): markers on the minimap and the world map, '?' over one to speak to.

talk.description: A person to speak to (a '?' over the target).

count.description: It counts by itself: what the taker holds now, what they fell, a number the story keeps.

on.description: It is done when this holds (and its target says `say`).

QuestTrigger.description: What makes a stage or an objective hold (docs/quests.md §2.2): data, each kind listening for some news.

on.description: What sets it (news it listens for, state it holds on); without one, only a notice (`stage`) sets it.

from.description: The stages it may follow (default: any lower).

hint.description: What the companion tells while it is the stage (default: its log).

say.description: A line said on reaching it, by an alias (default: the one spoken to, else the giver).

take.description: Things handed over on reaching it: from an alias (default the taker) to an alias (default the giver).

do.description: Effects run as the quest's own outcome (a scene, another quest begun, news for the story).

lessons.description: The tutorial's drills while it is the stage (docs/prologue.md).

items.description: Things made into the taker's bag; an item may be a named piece (its name, tags such as its quality, props such as its defence).

facts.description: Facts the story is told to keep.

regard.description: What aliases think of the taker after.

karma.description: How the deed weighs on the taker's good and evil (their `karma`); unsaid, a kindness to someone (regard given) is +3.

faith.description: How it weighs on the taker's faith (their `faith`).

RoleRef.description: A role, or the cell under it (`tileOf:`: the thing that makes up that cell on top — what fills it, roots in it, or the floor).

on.description: The grounds it appears on (terrain ids); any ground one can stand on when absent.

max.description: At most this many on the map: those tagged `tag` if it is given, else those of its types.

every.description: Ticks between appearances (a multiple of the `appear` period).

ring.description: How far from the one at the keys, [near, far] cells (default: anywhere, not within two).

hours.description: When: hours [from, to) (past midnight when from > to), and weathers.

night.description: When: at night, however long the story's night has grown (World.isNight; instead of hours).

where.description: Which maps (for the world's own): by the map's zone and light.

tag.description: A tag what appears carries (counted by `max`).

temper.description: When it attacks those its factions are hostile to: always, after dark only, or only once provoked. Whoever strikes it becomes a foe, whatever its temper.

foes.description: Whoever struck it: attacked on sight.

leash.description: How far from where it lives (home, or its night roam) it will chase before it gives up (default 8).

detour.description: The way around an obstacle it is following, to the goal it was planned for.

noWay.description: A goal no way led to (one shut in a house): it does not look for a way there again until then.

night.description: Where it roams at night (creatures come out after dark); by day it keeps to `home`.

ai.description: A creature's behaviour (its home is where it appears), and statuses it appears with.

AppearDef.description: What appears by itself (world-model.md §6.9; Don't Starve's twigs and flint, Minecraft's mobs, the night's walkers): data only. Now and then one more of the weighted types appears on a free cell of the right ground, at the right distance from the one at the keys, at the right hours and weather, until `max` of them are on the map.

z.description: The storey (world-model.md §5.2): 0 the ground's, 1 the floor above it … (omitted: 0).

Impulse.description: The impulses: what one thing does to another (design.md §5.8).

EmitTo.description: Where an emitted event goes: a role, a resident host, a named thing, or a place of the host's map.

say.description: The companion's one short line as it begins.

key.description: The key drawn over the focus ('F', 'LMB', 'RMB', 'E', 'C', 'B', 'R', '1', 'WASD', 'Tab', 'M', 'hold G').

focus.description: What is spotlit: the nearest thing of a type (with a status), the nearest cell of a terrain (nearest to `from`, else to the leader: the grove's trees, not the forest's rim), the leader, a spot, cells (an outline), or a panel's part (`ui`).

allow.description: While it lasts, only these inputs work (the rest do nothing; the key shakes). None: every input works.

only.description: Making and setting down: only these (a recipe's or a type's id, a placement recipe's id).

cells.description: Setting down what `only` names: only on these cells.

done.description: Done when this holds (state, never path).

Lesson.description: One lesson of a guide's stage (docs/prologue.md, the drills): it teaches one thing by the deed — what is shown (a thing spotlit, the key drawn over it), what the keys may do meanwhile, and the state that ends it. A guide's stage holds its lessons in order; the one at hand is the first not yet done (the story keeps `lesson.<id>`).

LessonInput.description: What a lesson lets the keys do (docs/prologue.md, the drills): moving, the five inputs, choosing a toolbar slot, making (C), setting a thing down from the build palette (B) and its turn (R), and the panels (the bag, the map). The input's own concern: which actor the keys move is not asked.

map.description: The leader is on this map.

region.description: The leader stands in this region (of `map`, else of their map): looked at when they enter it, and as a step plays — never polled.

quest.description: Quests' stages (0 before one begins; a quest over keeps the stage it ended at): docs/quests.md.

objectives.description: Quests' objectives done (`quest.objective`: the warden down, Fennick heard).

carrying.description: The leader carries (hand or bag) something of a type starting with this (each of these, for a list).

statuses.description: The leader has (true) or has not (false) these statuses (out cold, down).

skill.description: The leader has learned a skill: any (true) or this one.

near.description: Something of a type starting with this stands within r tiles of the leader (in view), with this status if one is named (a lit fire); `exact`: of that type itself (a shut door, not an open one).

holding.description: The leader holds (in hand) something of a type starting with this.

spot.description: The leader stands within r tiles of this spot (of their map).

on.description: At least `count` (1) things of a type starting with this stand on these cells of the leader's map.

room.description: A room with this role (bedroom, kitchen …) stands on the leader's map.

morningAfter.description: The first morning (05:00, when the night ends) after another step played has come.

StepCond.description: What starts a step of the story's script (world-model.md §6.12), on the one at the keys (the leader) and the story: all that is given must hold.

NewsKind.description: What happened, as the quests hear it (docs/quests.md §2.3).

with.description: Whose talk panel it shows in.

at.description: At which stages (default: whenever the quest runs).

QuestTopic.description: A topic of the quest's in the talk panel (Bethesda's quest dialogue): with an alias, at some stages.
